sources.title: Proteogenomic analysis of chemo-refractory high-grade serous ovarian cancer
sources.locator: Results: protein panel; Figure 3D; STAR Methods: prediction and FFPE/frozen alignment
sources.takeaway: Published 64-protein panel and cohort-specific evaluation, with incomplete sensitivity.
sources.limitations: Full manuscript via Europe PMC; publisher/PMC HTML inaccessible. Interpret cohort independence and validation design carefully; see S11.

sources.title: Tracking clonal evolution during treatment in ovarian cancer using cell-free DNA
sources.locator: Abstract; evolution of drug resistance; discussion
sources.takeaway: Longitudinal clonal tracking supports selection of pre-existing HGSOC clones during treatment.
sources.limitations: Publisher full text initially readable; later fetch redirected to inaccessible identity service. Abstract cross-checked in Europe PMC. Observational/mechanistic results are not a trial proving improved survival from adaptive therapy.

sources.title: Mapping spatial organization and genetic cell-state regulators to target immune evasion in ovarian cancer
sources.takeaway: Spatial and perturbational work links malignant cell states and immune interactions in high-grade serous tubo-ovarian cancer.
sources.limitations: Publisher route inaccessible; full article read via Europe PMC XML. Experimental immune-cell killing does not establish patient survival benefit.

sources.title: FDA mirvetuximab soravtansine-gynx approval notice, March 22 2024
sources.takeaway: Restricted FRα-positive platinum-resistant indication; exact eligibility is retained in the frontier document.
sources.limitations: An approval notice is not a cure claim or evidence that AI caused the advance; not a prescribing guide.

sources.title: FDA pembrolizumab with paclitaxel approval notice, February 10 2026
sources.takeaway: Restricted PD-L1-positive platinum-resistant indication; exact regimen and eligibility are retained in the frontier document.
sources.limitations: Not a general ovarian cancer immunotherapy indication or prescribing guide; not an AI attribution.

sources.title: International multicenter validation of AI-driven ultrasound detection of ovarian cancer
sources.locator: Abstract; methods: patient selection and retrospective evaluation
sources.takeaway: Retrospective characterization of ovarian lesions across centers.
sources.limitations: Publisher page and Europe PMC full-text methods inspected. Does not establish asymptomatic population screening efficacy or mortality reduction.

sources.title: Ovarian, Fallopian Tube, and Primary Peritoneal Cancers Screening PDQ, health professional version
sources.locator: Evidence of lack of mortality benefit associated with screening
sources.takeaway: Randomized evidence summarized by NCI finds no mortality reduction for studied CA-125/ultrasound screening strategies in average-risk populations.
sources.limitations: Do not extrapolate a lesion classifier to screening or high-risk populations.

sources.title: Author code: CPTAC Ovarian Chemo Response
sources.takeaway: Pinned inspected commit: 48357fd63ccbfe3954f38c8efc558b4f88bd6051. R script references local input/helper files and a literal plot AUC label.
sources.limitations: Code was not executed or copied. Availability of every input/helper, dependencies, licenses and numerical reproducibility remain unverified.

sources.title: PDC processed quantitation documentation
sources.locator: Explore Quantitative Data section (search-index extract only)
sources.takeaway: Official documentation entry point for processed quantitation discovery.
sources.limitations: Original URL and current usage route returned a page shell/no readable body. Search extract located the section; current download procedure and terms remain to be reviewed before ingestion.

sources.title: PDC HGSOC study metadata and publication mapping
sources.locator: Read-only study(pdc_study_id) queries: pdc_study_id and study_name, all six IDs; PDC publications listing
sources.takeaway: Proteome mapping: FFPE discovery 360, FFPE validation 358, frozen validation 362; matched phosphoproteomes 359/357/361.
sources.limitations: Portal browser extraction showed a page shell; study names verified by metadata API and publication listing. Open listing is not file-level access or reuse verification. No data files downloaded.

sources.title: Correction to the 2023 Cell proteogenomic study
sources.locator: Correction paragraph; bibliographic identity cross-checked via PubMed/Europe PMC, PMID 38364782
sources.takeaway: The correction concerns supplemental figure legends; corrected legends are now associated with the online article.
sources.limitations: Publisher/PMC HTML and Europe PMC XML retrieval failed; correction text verified through NCBI BioC. Pin the corrected supplementary materials before protocol freeze.
